title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
blurb: Elizabeth Bennet decides Mr Darcy is unbearable within an hour of meeting him. Five sisters, one estate, and a lot of letters.

title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
blurb: Emma Woodhouse is sure she knows who everyone in the village should marry. She is wrong about nearly all of them.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Brontë
blurb: An orphan becomes a governess at Thornfield Hall, where something is kept locked on the third floor.

title: Wuthering Heights
author: Emily Brontë
blurb: Two families on the Yorkshire moors, and a love that turns into something closer to a curse.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
blurb: Meg, Jo, Beth and Amy grow up in Massachusetts while their father is away at war.

title: The Great Gatsby
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
blurb: Nick Carraway rents a cottage next to a mansion where the parties never stop, and meets the man who throws them.

title: Persuasion
author: Jane Austen
blurb: Eight years after she was talked out of marrying him, Anne Elliot meets Captain Wentworth again.

title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
blurb: Twelve cases from 221B Baker Street, including the red-headed league and the speckled band.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
blurb: A family curse, a footprint on the moor, and Holmes sending Watson ahead alone.

title: The Murder of Roger Ackroyd
author: Agatha Christie
blurb: A village doctor helps Poirot investigate a death. The ending still starts arguments.

title: The Mysterious Affair at Styles
author: Agatha Christie
blurb: Hercule Poirot's first case: a poisoning at a country house during the First World War.

title: The Moonstone
author: Wilkie Collins
blurb: A sacred diamond disappears from a Yorkshire house the night after a birthday party.

title: The Woman in White
author: Wilkie Collins
blurb: A drawing teacher meets a woman dressed in white on a dark road outside London, and can't let it go.

title: The Thirty-Nine Steps
author: John Buchan
blurb: Richard Hannay finds a dead man in his flat and has to run across Scotland to clear his name.

title: The Secret Adversary
author: Agatha Christie
blurb: Two broke friends start a business doing 'anything, anywhere' and get exactly that.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
blurb: A student builds a man from what he can find, then runs from what he made.

title: Dracula
author: Bram Stoker
blurb: Told through diaries and letters: a London lawyer travels to Transylvania to close a property sale.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
blurb: A young man stays beautiful while his portrait in the attic ages for him.

title: Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
blurb: A respected doctor and a violent stranger seem to share a door, a cheque book, and a secret.

title: Carmilla
author: Sheridan Le Fanu
blurb: A lonely girl in a Styrian castle befriends a guest who sleeps all day. It came 25 years before Dracula.

title: The Turn of the Screw
author: Henry James
blurb: A governess believes the children in her care are being visited by two dead servants.

title: The Yellow Wallpaper
author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman
blurb: A woman confined to a rented room for a 'rest cure' starts to see something in the wallpaper.

title: The Phantom of the Opera
author: Gaston Leroux
blurb: Something lives under the Paris Opera, and it has opinions about who should sing.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
blurb: A Victorian inventor travels to the year 802,701 and finds humanity split in two.

title: The War of the Worlds
author: H. G. Wells
blurb: Cylinders land in the fields of Surrey. Then they start to open.

title: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under the Sea
author: Jules Verne
blurb: Three men are taken aboard the Nautilus by Captain Nemo, who has no plans to let them leave.

title: The Invisible Man
author: H. G. Wells
blurb: A stranger wrapped in bandages takes a room at a country inn and refuses to take off his gloves.

title: The Island of Doctor Moreau
author: H. G. Wells
blurb: A shipwrecked man lands on an island where a banished surgeon has been doing experiments.

title: A Princess of Mars
author: Edgar Rice Burroughs
blurb: A Civil War veteran wakes up on Mars, where the low gravity makes him the strongest man alive.

title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
author: Jules Verne
blurb: A professor finds a coded note in an old book and heads for a volcano in Iceland.

title: Flatland
author: Edwin Abbott
blurb: A square who lives in two dimensions is visited by a sphere. A short book about seeing more.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
blurb: Jim Hawkins finds a map in a dead sailor's chest. Long John Silver signs on as cook.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
author: Alexandre Dumas
blurb: Edmond Dantès is jailed on his wedding day for a crime he didn't commit. He has time to plan.

title: Moby-Dick
author: Herman Melville
blurb: Ishmael signs on to a whaling ship whose captain only cares about one whale.

title: Around the World in Eighty Days
author: Jules Verne
blurb: Phileas Fogg bets half his fortune that he can circle the globe in eighty days, and leaves that evening.

title: The Call of the Wild
author: Jack London
blurb: Buck, a big house dog from California, is stolen and sold to work a sled in the Yukon.

title: Robinson Crusoe
author: Daniel Defoe
blurb: Twenty-eight years alone on an island, told by the man who kept the calendar.

title: The Three Musketeers
author: Alexandre Dumas
blurb: D'Artagnan arrives in Paris wanting to join the musketeers and picks a duel with three of them on day one.

title: The Jungle Book
author: Rudyard Kipling
blurb: Mowgli is raised by wolves and taught by a bear and a panther. Plus Rikki-Tikki-Tavi.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
blurb: Alice follows a rabbit with a pocket watch down a hole, and nothing is the right size after that.

title: The Wonderful Wizard of Oz
author: L. Frank Baum
blurb: A Kansas farmhouse lands in Oz, and Dorothy walks the yellow brick road to find a way home.

title: Peter Pan
author: J. M. Barrie
blurb: The boy who won't grow up teaches the Darling children to fly to Neverland.

title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
blurb: A spoiled orphan sent to a Yorkshire manor finds a garden that has been locked for ten years.

title: Anne of Green Gables
author: L. M. Montgomery
blurb: The Cuthberts asked for a boy to help on the farm. They got Anne, who talks a lot.

title: Winnie-the-Pooh
author: A. A. Milne
blurb: A bear of very little brain and his friends in the Hundred Acre Wood.

title: The Wind in the Willows
author: Kenneth Grahame
blurb: Mole, Rat, Badger and the very reckless Mr Toad, along the river.

title: Black Beauty
author: Anna Sewell
blurb: The life of a London cab horse, told by the horse.

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
blurb: Notes a Roman emperor wrote to himself about staying calm and doing his job well.

title: The Art of War
author: Sun Tzu
blurb: Thirteen short chapters on strategy, still quoted in boardrooms and locker rooms.

title: Walden
author: Henry David Thoreau
blurb: Thoreau spends two years in a cabin he built by a pond, and reports back.

title: The Prince
author: Niccolò Machiavelli
blurb: A handbook on getting power and keeping it, written by a diplomat out of work.

title: The Republic
author: Plato
blurb: Socrates and friends try to define justice by designing a city from scratch.

title: Siddhartha
author: Hermann Hesse
blurb: A young man leaves home to find out what life is for, and tries almost everything.

title: Beyond Good and Evil
author: Friedrich Nietzsche
blurb: Nietzsche takes apart the philosophers who came before him, one aphorism at a time.

title: The Prophet
author: Kahlil Gibran
blurb: Twenty-six prose poems on love, work, children and death, spoken by a man about to sail home.

title: Leaves of Grass
author: Walt Whitman
blurb: Whitman's book of everything: bodies, cities, grass, and himself.

title: The Odyssey
author: Homer
blurb: Ten years to get home from a war, and every island on the way has a problem.

title: Poems
author: Emily Dickinson
blurb: The first collection of Emily Dickinson, published four years after she died.

title: The Divine Comedy
author: Dante Alighieri
blurb: Dante walks through Hell, climbs Purgatory and reaches Paradise, with Virgil as his guide.

title: Paradise Lost
author: John Milton
blurb: The fall of Satan and of Adam and Eve, in twelve books of blank verse.

title: The Waste Land
author: T. S. Eliot
blurb: 434 lines that changed modern poetry. Read it out loud.

title: Crime and Punishment
author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky
blurb: Raskolnikov kills a pawnbroker to prove a theory about himself. Then he has to live with it.

title: Great Expectations
author: Charles Dickens
blurb: Pip, a blacksmith's boy, comes into money from someone who won't give their name.

title: A Christmas Carol
author: Charles Dickens
blurb: Scrooge gets three visitors on Christmas Eve, and one very bad night's sleep.

title: The Metamorphosis
author: Franz Kafka
blurb: Gregor Samsa wakes up as a giant insect and mostly worries about being late for work.

title: Mrs Dalloway
author: Virginia Woolf
blurb: One day in London in June 1923. Clarissa is throwing a party tonight.

title: Ulysses
author: James Joyce
blurb: One day in Dublin, 16 June 1904, following Leopold Bloom around the city.

title: Don Quixote
author: Miguel de Cervantes
blurb: A man reads too many books about knights and decides to become one.

title: Heart of Darkness
author: Joseph Conrad
blurb: Marlow takes a steamboat up the Congo River to find an ivory trader named Kurtz.

title: Middlemarch
author: George Eliot
blurb: A whole English town, and Dorothea Brooke, who wants to do some good in it.

title: Les Misérables
author: Victor Hugo
blurb: Jean Valjean steals bread, serves nineteen years, and spends the rest of his life being chased by Javert.
